ObsidianUI Dashboard Shell stylesheet
Source: https://www.obsidianui.dev/r/dashboard-shell.json
Upstream: https://github.com/Atharvsinh-codez/ObsidianUI

The original palette and scrollbar stylesheet is used with a native HTML/CSS adaptation in ../obsidian-theme.css. React shell behavior is not bundled. DeepGuard retains its existing JavaScript navigation and analysis logic.
